title: gatewatch: constitution changed without human review
description: Evidence: commit 9a0f708c5fd3d60fcafbab5c7ce8e646705b7023, docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires explicit human review for merged changes to the constitution; this governance commit was merged on main with no explicit human sign-off recorded in the seed tracker (which was empty at audit time). The commit subject and diff are otherwise aligned, but the protected mandate change itself is the finding.

title: gatewatch: audit trigger entries changed without human review
description: Evidence: commit 123db0b27c5cd0bb2dc4b698a211660abf9e1f00, .warren/triggers.yaml lines 1-47, including gatewatch/ratchetwatch/tastewatch audit entries. Article IX requires explicit human review for changes to .warren/triggers.yaml audit entries; this commit was merged on main with no explicit human sign-off recorded in the seed tracker (empty at audit time). The commit subject and diff are aligned, but the protected audit mandate was changed without recorded approval.
